images.prompt:
Original premium Christmas greeting-card illustration in hand-painted storybook watercolour on subtly textured cold-pressed paper; full colour with muted ivory, winter blue-grey, pine and sage, warm brown, restrained berry red, and antique-gold accents. Soft translucent pigment layers, lightly mottled washes, dry-brush texture, gentle granular highlights and occasional diffused light flecks. Predominantly painterly and outline-free, with sparse fine broken pencil-like marks only for delicate texture and definition. Render characters, when present, with softly rounded believable anatomy, mildly enlarged expressive eyes and tender natural facial modelling. Medium-to-high focal detail, softened low-contrast supporting detail, graceful framing shapes, legible text space, diffuse warm glow and gentle shadow modelling; cosy, nostalgic, quietly magical handmade print feel.

SHARED STYLE (style only): illustration style: Original hand-painted storybook watercolour for a premium Christmas greeting card, balancing tender naturalism with gentle festive fantasy.; line weight: Mostly outline-free, with only very fine, intermittent pencil-like detail marks for texture and definition.; line quality: Organic, softly broken and directional; painted edges feather naturally into the paper rather than forming crisp digital contours.; detail level: Medium to high detail, concentrated on the focal forms and a small number of atmospheric festive accents; distant or supporting elements remain soft and simplified for reliable home printing.; character language: Appealing, broadly believable woodland-animal anatomy with softly rounded forms, mildly enlarged expressive eyes, delicate facial modelling, and calm, kind expressions.; background density: Flexible from airy paper-led space to an intimate layered vignette; backgrounds use softened depth, low-contrast receding detail, and clear areas for readable wording.; palette: Muted traditional Christmas hues: cream and ivory, blue-grey winter tones, pine and sage greens, warm woodland browns, restrained berry red, and concentrated antique-gold highlights.; colour mode: full colour; shading: Layered translucent washes and soft tonal modelling, with subtle dry-brush definition, diffuse warm glows, gentle rim light, and no hard-edged cel shading.; texture: Visible cold-pressed watercolour paper grain, lightly mottled pigment blooms, restrained dry-brush marks, granular snowy highlights, and occasional soft bokeh-like flecks.; mood: Cosy, nostalgic, tender and quietly magical, with a refined handmade feel suited to seasonal gifting.; print considerations: Optimised for high-resolution A4 or US Letter home printing and trimming or folding: retain strong value contrast behind all wording, use print-safe focal details rather than hairline-dependent features, avoid expansive dark ink-heavy fields, and allow a clean trim-safe outer area..

REFERENCE CHARACTERISTICS (general only, never copied): palette: Classic muted Christmas palette: evergreen, sage and pine; warm animal browns; creamy white snow and paper; antique gold; rusty red, burgundy, and occasional warm orange. Colours are earthy and gently desaturated rather than bright primary holiday hues.; linework: Reference 01 uses very fine, irregular pencil/ink-like contour and fur strokes, approximately 0.5–1 px at card-preview scale. References 02–03 are painterly and largely outline-free; forms are separated by value, texture, and rim light rather than graphic linework.; texture: Visible cold-pressed paper/wash texture, mottled pigment, soft dry-brush effects, fine fur strokes, knitted textile detail, granular snow, and bokeh-like light specks. Texture is decorative but supports form and atmosphere.; composition density: Varies from sparse portrait-led layout to dense cinematic vignettes. Use one clearly dominant focal subject; surrounding festive details should create a framing arc and depth without obscuring the subject.; background: From a near-white paper field with restrained flecks to layered, atmospheric winter environments. Complex scenes contain foreground, middle-ground, and softly receding background detail, with selective blur or low contrast at depth.; mood: Cosy, tender, nostalgic, magical, and quietly festive. The animals feel sweet and personable, while golden lighting conveys warmth and wonder..
